remarks: A breathtaking waterfront retreat where architecture, craftsmanship, and setting unite in rare harmony. Designed by renowned architect Roger Bartels and built by one of Westport's most respected builders, Don Miro, this sophisticated beach house captures panoramic water views from each and every room. The current owners have thoughtfully enhanced the property with extensive updates, including meticulously designed new landscaping and hardscaping, and a spectacular 1000-square-foot glass-walled deck - the perfect vantage point to soak in sweeping water views. Additional updates throughout this exceptional residence include all-new white oak floors and new technology and systems. Primary suite with soaring vaulted ceiling and private glass-walled office and 2 additional ensuite bedrooms with vaulted ceilings, all with water views. Situated on a coveted Compo Beach cul-de-sac, the property offers both serenity and access - launch a paddle board or kayak from your own shore, then stroll to Old Mill Beach and Old Mill Grocery Cafe for sunset and a glass of wine. Soaring ceilings, curved walls, bespoke millwork, and flawless finishes define its refined interiors, while the dramatic exteriors and views impress. A home as rare as its setting, this is waterfront living at its most elevated - a private escape that embodies Westport's most coveted lifestyle, just minutes from downtown Westport's shops and restaurants, and a world away from the ordinary.
